missions.paragraph: Document visible damage to buildings for post-event infrastructure assessment. Do not infer occupancy, structural safety, cause, or rescue urgency.
conditions: a photograph documenting visible damage to buildings

missions.paragraph: Document visible obstructions on roads for an access survey. Keep an obstruction on the road distinct from debris beside it; do not infer conditions outside the view.
conditions: a photograph of a road blocked by an obstruction

missions.paragraph: Document visible physical damage to roads for an infrastructure survey. Distinguish damage from obstruction and do not infer repair urgency or trafficability.
conditions: a photograph documenting visible physical damage to a road

missions.paragraph: Photograph visible household furniture and appliances for a personal inventory. Record what is present without assigning emergency importance.
conditions: a photograph documenting household furniture and appliances

missions.paragraph: Collect informative visual documentation of disaster-related incidents. Report visible evidence and uncertainty without inventing injury, identity, cause, or operational urgency.
conditions: a photograph providing informative visual evidence about a disaster incident
